mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.story_version_id, c.row_version, v.content_hash AS source_hash, v.content AS source_text, v.id AS content_variant_id, v.language_code, v.source_variant_id FROM chapters c JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id JOIN chapter_content_variants v ON v.chapter_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND p.id = #{projectId} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND (((#{contentVariantId} IS NULL) AND v.variant_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND v.content_hash = c.source_hash) OR v.id = #{contentVariantId}) ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1
